meta.name: The Simpsons: Holidays
meta.description: Holiday episodes in calendar order. Season 1: Valentine's Day, 2: St. Patrick's Day, 3: Easter, 4: Halloween, 5: Thanksgiving, 6: Christmas.

videos.title: Valentine's Day: I Love Lisa
videos.overview: Chief Wiggum's son has a crush on Lisa after she gives him a Valentine out of pity.

videos.title: Valentine's Day: I'm with Cupid
videos.overview: Apu is making the husbands of Springfield look bad with his extravagent Valentine's Day efforts for Manjula. When the men try to sabotage Apu's grand gesture, they accidentally wind up benefiting from it.

videos.title: Valentine's Day: Love, Springfieldian Style
videos.overview: Homer and Marge celebrate Valentine's Day by going on the Tunnel of Love ride at a carnival, but they end up stranded when Bart pulls a prank involving gelatin. To pass the time, Homer tells the love story of Bonnie and Clyde, Marge tells her version of "Lady and the Tramp," and

videos.title: Valentine's Day: The Daughter Also Rises
videos.overview: Marge and Lisa's plans for a mother-daughter Valentine's Day take a turn when Lisa falls head over heels for an intellectual romantic; Bart and Milhouse investigate Springfield Elementary's legends.

videos.title: St. Patrick's Day: Homer vs. the Eighteenth Amendment
videos.overview: When Prohibition is revived in Springfield, Homer and Bart supply the town with alcohol.

videos.title: Easter: Simpsons Bible Stories
videos.overview: When Reverend Lovejoy subjects the congregation to an extended Bible reading, the Simpsons fall asleep and have dreams based on Bible stories.

videos.title: Easter: The Last of the Red Hat Mamas
videos.overview: Marge is shunned after Homer has an altercation with the Easter Bunny at the mayor's egg hunt. A lonely Marge joins a women's group who plan to steal $1 million from Mr Burns.

videos.title: Easter: Dark Knight Court
videos.overview: Springfield's Easter is ruined by a prank and all fingers point to Bart. It is up to Lisa to save her brother, in a student court presided over by Attorney General Janet Reno. Meanwhile, inspired by an old comic book, Mr. Burns becomes an ineffectual superhero—fruit bat man.

videos.title: Halloween: Halloween of Horror
videos.overview: When Lisa becomes scared at the Krustyland Halloween Horror Night, Homer is forced to take down his Everscream Terrors decorations. Halloween pop-up employees seek vengeance on Homer for causing them to lose their jobs, and rob his house while Homer and Lisa hide out in the attic

videos.title: Halloween: Not It
videos.overview: Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

videos.title: Halloween: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
videos.overview: Sideshow Bob teams up with the most infamous villains of Disney+ to share the true meaning of the Halloween season. Filled with music, mayhem, and madness, this short from "The Simpsons" is simply to die for.

videos.title: Thanksgiving: Bart vs. Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Lisa makes a table centerpiece for the Thanksgiving dinner, which Bart accidentally destroys. After he is sent to his room by his parents, Bart angrily runs away from home and experiences a very different kind of Thanksgiving holiday.

videos.title: Thanksgiving: Homer vs. Dignity
videos.overview: When the Simpsons once again have financial problems, Mr. Burns pays Homer to play pranks on others and humiliate himself in public. Meanwhile, Smithers creates a Malibu Stacy-themed musical.

videos.title: Thanksgiving: Thanksgiving of Horror
videos.overview: The Simpsons face various Thanksgiving nightmares, including the first Thanksgiving, an A.I. mishap and a dangerous space mission complicated by a sentient cranberry sauce.

videos.title: Thanksgiving: It's a Blunderful Life
videos.overview: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

videos.title: Christmas: Simpsons Roasting on an Open Fire
videos.overview: Homer's Christmas bonus is canceled and the rainy-day funds are needed to pay for Bart's tattoo removal.

videos.title: Christmas: Marge Be Not Proud
videos.overview: Nabbed for shoplifting, Bart manages to keep it a secret from the family... until it's time to have the family Christmas photo taken at the Try-N-Save.

videos.title: Christmas: Miracle on Evergreen Terrace
videos.overview: After accidentally ruining the family’s Christmas tree and presents, Bart buries the evidence and claims a burglar stole everything. When Kent Brockman does a human interest story on the family’s tragic loss, the townspeople shower the family with generosity… until the truth come

videos.title: Christmas: Grift of the Magi
videos.overview: In this Christmas-themed episode, the students of Springfield Elementary are unwittingly used as a focus group to test new toys. The product of their labors, a cuddly doll named Funzo, is a lot more sinister than he appears.

videos.title: Christmas: Homer vs. Dignity
videos.overview: When the Simpsons once again have financial problems, Mr. Burns pays Homer to play pranks on others and humiliate himself in public. Meanwhile, Smithers creates a Malibu Stacy-themed musical.

videos.title: Christmas: Skinner's Sense of Snow
videos.overview: A snowstorm traps the students of Springfield Elementary inside, with them overthrowing Principal Skinner when he uses his Army skills to control them. Meanwhile, Homer tries to rescue the children–using Flanders' car.

videos.title: Christmas: She of Little Faith
videos.overview: After Homer and Bart's model rocket damages the church, Mr. Burns makes a deal to commercialize the church in return for paying for the damages. Lisa becomes disgusted at what the church has become, so she decides to find a new religion suitable for her. She eventually converts t

videos.title: Christmas: Dude, Where's My Ranch?
videos.overview: When challenged to think up a new Christmas carol, Homer instead writes a song about how much he hates Ned Flanders. The song becomes such a hit that the Simpsons become sick of hearing it and take a trip to a dude ranch. Lisa develops affections for a local boy named Luke but be

videos.title: Christmas: 'Tis the Fifteenth Season
videos.overview: Homer realizes how selfish he is after he spends all the family's Christmas money on a present for himself. He becomes the nicest guy in town, making Ned Flanders jealous.

videos.title: Christmas: Simpsons Christmas Stories
videos.overview: The Simpsons re-enact the Nativity; a World War II tale stars Grampa, Mr. Burns and Santa; a musical features "The Nutcracker Suite."

videos.title: Christmas: Kill Gil, Volumes I & II
videos.overview: Homer jumps into a brawl during a holiday ice-skating show. To escape the melee, Marge takes the family Christmas shopping, where a chance encounter with Gil leads to bad luck for Gil and the Simpson clan.

videos.title: Christmas: Eternal Moonshine of the Simpson Mind
videos.overview: Homer loses his memory--and his family--when he drinks Moe's most potent libation, the Forget-Me-Shot, in an episode that spoofs "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind" and "It's a Wonderful Life."

videos.title: Christmas: The Simpsons' Christmas Message
videos.overview: Marge comments on David and Victoria Beckham's marriage in a negative comparison with hers and Homer's, and compared the special relationship between the UK and the US to that of Mini Me and Dr. Evil in the Austin Powers films ("Helping out in all our zany schemes to take over th

videos.title: Christmas: The Fight Before Christmas
videos.overview: When the rest of the family seems to lack Christmas spirit, Marge contacts Martha Clause.

videos.title: Christmas: Holidays of Future Passed
videos.overview: Thirty years in the future, Bart, Lisa and their children spend the holidays at Marge and Homer's house.

videos.title: Christmas: White Christmas Blues
videos.overview: Springfield is inundated with holiday revelers after the nuclear power plant springs a radiation leak, causing snow to fall all over town. When the tourists drive up Christmas shopping prices, Marge opens up the Simpsons' house to boarders.

videos.title: Christmas: I Won't Be Home for Christmas
videos.overview: After Moe convinces Homer to stay out drinking on Christmas Eve, Marge tells Homer not to come home. This leads to Homer's sad trek through lonely Springfield, where he learns that the only place where one should truly get drunk on Christmas is home.

videos.title: Christmas: The Nightmare After Krustmas
videos.overview: Krusty tries to impress his daughter as they spend Christmas with the Simpsons. Meanwhile, Reverend Lovejoy seeks converts after church attendance plummets, and Maggie is haunted by a spooky Christmas toy.

videos.title: Christmas: Gone Boy
videos.overview: When Bart goes missing, the town puts together a search party to find him. After most give up hope, Sideshow Bob manipulates Millhouse into revealing where Bart is hiding.

videos.title: Christmas: 'Tis the 30th Season
videos.overview: After a failed Black Friday shopping spree, Marge is determined to fix Christmas; Homer and the kids surprise Marge with a vacation to a Florida resort.

videos.title: Christmas: Bobby: It's Cold Outside
videos.overview: Sideshow Bob gets contracted as this year’s mall Santa. Meanwhile, someone is stealing all the Christmas packages off people’s front porches.

videos.title: Christmas: The Way of the Dog
videos.overview: Santa's Little Helper nips at Marge, causing the family to reflect on the difficult life that the dog led prior to being adopted by the family. They end up reuniting him with his mother to avoid having to euthanize him.

videos.title: Christmas: A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
videos.overview: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

videos.title: Christmas: Manger Things
videos.overview: A secret of Flanders' Past and a never-before-seen room of the Simpson house are shown off.

videos.title: Christmas: The Simpsons Meet the Bocellis in "Feliz Navidad"
videos.overview: This Christmas, Homer surprises Marge with the ultimate gift: an unforgettable performance from Italian opera superstar Andrea Bocelli and his children Matteo and Virginia.

videos.title: Christmas: The Simpsons: O C'mon All Ye Faithful
videos.overview: The residents of Springfield search for Christmas cheer.
